_comment: Ratchet of licence findings in BUILT images (scripts/license-gate-image.mjs). Kept apart from licenses/known-violations.json because
the repo-wide gate (scripts/license-gate.mjs) resolves requirements files, not images, and would report these entries as stale.
Same rules as that file: NOT a waiver; --strict fails on them; an entry whose package is gone or fixed is STALE and fails the image
gate; AGPL, EUPL and source-available licences can never be listed. The image gate also applies the repo-wide list to the packages it finds.

violations.name: psycopg
violations.reason: litellm-oss image (2026-11-24): the pure-Python psycopg, unmodified, on the system libpq5. NOT optional in LiteLLM 1.109.1: litellm-proxy-extras 0.4.113 declares it and both migration resolvers import it unguarded (measured: db-migrate exits with ModuleNotFoundError without it). The upstream image the chart ran before ships it too, plus psycopg-binary. Owner decision pending: a reviewed exception ('unmodified-not-linked'), or the upstream change drafted in docs/components/litellm-oss.md. LGPL-3.0-only is copyleft: allowed only through a reviewed entry in licenses/exceptions.json
